item.title: 片山財務相、世銀・ＩＭＦ合同開発委議長に就任 日本として初
item.description:
Takaya Yamaguchi
［東京 １３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Takaya Yamaguchi

［東京　１３日　ロイター］ - 片山さつき財務相は１３日の閣議後会見で、世界銀行・国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）合同開発委員会の次期議長に就任すると発表した。１９７４年の委員会設置以来、日本からの議長就任は初めて。

１５日にタイ・バンコクで開催される委員会で正式に選任される見通し。任期は２０２８年１０月までの２年間となる。

正式就任に先立ち、片山財務相は「指名いただいたことは大変、光栄に思う」と言及。「日本が有する開発政策、それに関連する幅広い経済政策についての経験、知見や技術を生かしつつ、他国の協力も得ながら建設的な議論を主導していく」と述べた。

同日予定される２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）財務相・中央銀行総裁会議にも出席する方向で調整している。承認が得られ次第、現地に出張する予定。

item.title: インド9月インフレ率、中銀設定の上限に接近 利上げ観測強まる
item.description:
Shubham Batra
[ニューデリー １２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Shubham Batra

[ニューデリー １２日 ロイター] - １２日に発表された９月のインド小売物価上昇率は予想を上回る５．５４％へと加速し、中央銀行が設定した６％の上限に近づいた。

市場予想は５．４％、８月実績は４．８３％だった。

インフレ率が中銀の中期目標である４％を４カ月連続で上回った。主に食料価格の高騰によるもので、タマネギ、ショウガ、ニンニクなどの主要食料品価格が上昇したため、食料インフレ率は８月の５．９７％から７．７４％へと加速した。ベース効果で前年比上昇率が押し上げられた部分もある。

オックスフォード・エコノミクスのリードエコノミスト、アレクサンドラ・ヘルマン・プラサド氏は、さらなる利上げの必要性を裏付けるものだと指摘。「１２月と２月にそれぞれ２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げが実施されると予想している」と語った。

格付け機関ＩＣＲＡによると、食料や燃料など変動の激しい要素を除いたコアインフレ率は、８月の４．１６％から９月には４．６％に加速した。

中銀は２０２７年度のコアインフレ率を平均で４．４％と予測している。

item.title: Magnitude 6 earthquake strikes Panama, EMSC says
item.description: An earthquake of magnitude 6 struck Panama on Monday, the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre (EMSC) said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: An earthquake of magnitude 6 struck Panama on Monday, the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre (EMSC) said. The quake was at a depth of 35 km (22 miles), the EMSC said. Panama recorded more than 300 [USN:L6N45X08G TEXT:"aftershocks"] following [USN:L6N45V0ZT TEXT:"Friday's magnitude 7.7 earthquake"] that damaged hundreds of homes and infrastructure across the country's central provinces, prompting the government to declare a national state of emergency over the weekend. No deaths were reported, but at least 27 people were injured and nearly 900 homes were damaged, according to emergency authorities, who warned the toll could rise as assessments continue in remote communities. Among the most affected provinces are Los Santos, Cocle, Veraguas, and Herrera, authorities added.

item.title: 米移民当局、トランプ氏批判の民主党議員宅を捜索 中間選挙控え
item.description:
Nolan D. McCaskill Andrew Goudsward Doina Chiacu
[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Nolan D. McCaskill　Andrew Goudsward　Doina Chiacu

[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - 米当局は１２日、ワシントンにある民主党のオマル下院議員（ミネソタ州選出）の自宅を家宅捜索した。米司法省が明らかにした。進行中の捜査の一環としている。同氏はトランプ大統領を公然と批判してきた人物で、トランプ氏から政治的な侮辱の標的にされてきた。

関係者によると、捜査は移民手続きに絡む不正容疑に関するもので、ソマリア生まれのオマル氏が子どものころ、父親が記入した移民関連書類も対象となっている。

オマル氏は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）への投稿で、大統領の政敵を標的にするために政府が利用されていると批判。「トランプ氏は１０年にわたり、根拠のないうそと中傷で私を標的にしてきた」とし、「今回の件は、同氏による政治的威圧がさらにエスカレートした最新の例にすぎない。私は沈黙しない」と書き込んだ。

オマル氏は１１月３日の中間選挙で５選を目指している。

司法省報道官は、同省が取得した裁判所の捜索令状を国土安全保障捜査局が執行したと説明。「この執行措置は、現在進行中の連邦捜査の一環だ」と述べた。国土安全保障捜査局は、米移民・税関捜査局（ＩＣＥ）の一部門。

トランプ米政権で国境対策を統括するトム・ホーマン氏はＦＯＸビジネス・ネットワークに対し、司法省が国土安全保障省と共に捜査を主導していると述べた。進行中の刑事捜査の詳細については言及を控えた。

マリン国土安全保障長官は９月、オマル氏一家の米国入国を巡る捜査について「何かが起きる」と発言。保守派ポッドキャスターに対し「そもそもこの国にいるべきでなかったと証明できれば、国外退去させる」と述べていた。

今回の家宅捜索は、トランプ氏の共和党が議会の多数派維持を目指す中間選挙まで３週間余りの時期に行われた。

司法省の方針では、選挙結果に影響を及ぼしたり、候補者や政党に利益をもたらしたりする目的で、連邦検察官や捜査官が措置の実施時期を決めることを禁じている。同省は従来、選挙前の約６０日間は候補者に対する捜査措置を控えてきた。

下院民主党トップのジェフリーズ院内総務ら党指導部は声明で、家宅捜索は「極めて憂慮すべき」で、トランプ氏の敵対者に対する連邦政府の武器化について「深刻な問題を提起する」と懸念を示した。

ミネソタ州のウォルズ知事は「米国民はこの行為の本質を見抜いている。トランプ大統領は選挙を数週間後に控え、権力を乱用して政敵を追い詰めている」とＳＮＳに投稿した。

item.title: Saudi warning system stayed silent before deadly airport attacks
item.description: The government has not said why there were no alerts to the public. Their absence raises questions about Saudi Arabia's vulnerability to attack and about its ability to protect residents and visitors, four Western and Arab officials in the region and political analysts told Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Timour Azhari
item.content:encoded: Saudi Arabia stopped issuing public warnings of imminent military attacks days before a series of deadly strikes on Riyadh airport that killed at least 18 people and wounded more than 300. The government has not said why there were no alerts to the public before the four [USN:L6N45Y0OR TEXT:"Riyadh attacks"] in the past week. The warnings had served to highlight the violence undermining the kingdom's efforts to project an image of calm to its people and the world during its war with Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis. Their absence during the [USN:L6N45Y0C1 TEXT:"airport strikes"] raised questions about Saudi Arabia's vulnerability to attack and about its ability to protect residents and visitors, four Western and Arab officials in the region and political analysts told Reuters. It also reflected efforts to maintain a sense of normalcy, they said. "They (the Saudi government) want to have it both ways: to launch a military operation and at the same time try to give confidence to the population and external stakeholders," said Sultan Alamer, a US-based Saudi academic and Senior Resident Fellow at the Middle East Policy Council think tank. The Saudi civil defence - a national emergency management, rescue and firefighting agency which operates under the interior ministry and issues early warning alerts - and the Saudi government media office did not respond to emailed questions on why no alerts were issued. Saudi Arabia's approach is also one that some regional analysts said risked backfiring because the absence of warnings has heightened uncertainty in the kingdom. On Monday, Saudi Arabia's civil defence authority issued its first alerts since September 29, warning of potential threats in Riyadh and southern cities. Reuters was unable to ascertain whether the decision to issue alerts again was a response to the airport attacks, and the Saudi government did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the matter. SYSTEM GOES SILENT All Gulf countries have been hit by Iranian drones and missiles since the US-Iran war began in February, but their governments have handled public warnings differently. Qatar's interior ministry has issued mobile phone alerts before nearly every attack, including most recent attacks in July, when residents were warned to stay inside and away from windows. Bahrain and Kuwait have repeatedly sounded sirens urging people to take shelter. Saudi Arabia began issuing threat alerts to mobile phones and social media accounts via a national early warning system in May. But despite increasing Houthi attacks leading up to last week, the system went silent. The last alert before last week's attacks was issued on September 29, for the southern province of Najran, according to posts on the civil defence X account. The civil defences authority has continued to issue warnings about staying out of harm's way during adverse weather, including rain and flooding, and did so as recently as Monday. It also warned residents not to share images, rumours or information about interceptions and impact sites, including in a post on Monday, under government regulations issued in March. Reuters could not determine whether anyone had faced prosecution for sharing such information, and the Saudi government media office did not respond to a request for comment on the matter. Before last week's airport attacks, officials from an allied Western government asked Saudi authorities why the alerts had stopped, two officials with direct knowledge of the matter said. The response was that the alerts were too disruptive and many citizens had complained they were being woken by them at night, the officials said. The Saudi government media office and Saudi officials did not respond to requests for comment on the assertion. Former US ambassador to Saudi Arabia Michael Ratney said Riyadh was trying to balance public messaging on attacks with efforts to prevent disruption in the kingdom but had ended up adding to a sense of unease about the strikes. "Their approach to public messaging seems like a corollary to the quandary they are in: They need to respond to the Houthis but don't want that to result in societal disruption and their public messaging is a reflection of that," he said. "But the lack of alerts of incoming Houthi attacks creates the very nervousness they are trying to avoid." NEW THREAT ALERT Ali Shihabi, a Saudi analyst close to the government, said that with or without early warnings, the kingdom would struggle to defend all of its assets because of its size. "In Saudi Arabia you have too much to protect. It's a huge country with airports, pipelines and oil facilities. There is just not enough coverage to defend everything at once, not enough Patriots (missile defence systems), interceptors and missile batteries to do it all," he said. "Saudi Arabia has an unlimited need for air defences," he added." Despite the attacks, Saudi Arabia hosted an international conference on Monday, though major [USN:L6N45Y0GT TEXT:"oil bosses"] dropped out. At the World Petroleum Council Energy Congress in Riyadh, Saudi Prince Abdulaziz bin Salaman, a brother of the Saudi crown prince and the kingdom's energy minister, struck a defiant tone while acknowledging risks and Saudi Arabia's intent to keep its economic plans on track.He thanked all who had travelled to Riyadh "because you know this country is safe" but added: "Our gathering here does not mean the risk is gone.""We will never forfeit any chance to maintain our commitment and our vision," he said. EMBASSIES ISSUE THEIR OWN INTERNAL ALERTS Despite no public alerts being issued this month until Monday, Riyadh has been attacked about a dozen times, two of the Western officials said. During that time, Western embassies in the kingdom have been issuing their own internal missile and drone alerts to staff, according to three people familiar with the matter and alerts seen by Reuters. These internal alerts are compiled from a mixture of US and other Western government intelligence and input from Saudi authorities, one of those people said. They include alerts sent to staff around the time of two first airport strikes last week according to the people familiar with the matter. They said that even the embassies had received no internal warning before Saturday's airport strike, without offering an explanation. Reuters could not determine why no warning came before Saturday's attack, the deadliest of last week's attacks. On Sunday, Saudi state TV released footage of Saturday's strike. It showed several shots of travellers in the airport terminal. Dozens lined up to board a flight. Men and women sat in chairs waiting, their eyes trained on the screens of their mobile phones as they scrolled. Then, the bright orange flash of a missile explosion.

item.title: ウクライナ首都住宅ビルに攻撃、2人死亡・9人負傷＝大統領
item.description: [１２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１２日 ロイター] - ウクライナ当局が１２日に明らかにしたところによると、首都キーウにある高層住宅ビルがロシアの攻撃を受け、２人が死亡、少なくとも９人が負傷した。また、ウクライナの他の地域にも攻撃があり、少なくとも６人が死亡した。

ゼレンスキー大統領はテレグラムへの投稿で、ダルニツキー地区にある２５階建ての住宅ビルで２人が死亡し、９人が負傷したと述べた。

北東部にあるウクライナ第２の都市ハルキウでは、各地区で激しい砲撃があり、集合住宅の入り口が崩落して５人が負傷。地元当局者が明らかにした。住民ががれきの下に閉じ込められている可能性があるという。

ハルキウ州では、ロゾバ町がドローン（無人機）攻撃を受け、１人が死亡した。

攻撃により、東部ドネツク州のクラマトルスク近郊の村で少なくとも３人が死亡。キーウ周辺地域では、首都の南西にあるファスティフ町近郊で１人が死亡した。このほか、南東部の都市ドニプロでも１人が死亡した。

item.title: 植田日銀総裁、午後1時から衆院予算委に出席＝国会筋
item.description:
Yoshifumi Takemoto
［東京 １３日 ロイター］ - 国会筋によると日銀の植田和男総裁は...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
植田日銀総裁、午後1時から衆院予算委に出席＝国会筋 8:28 配信

植田日銀総裁。9月18日、東京で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Yoshifumi Takemoto

［東京　１３日　ロイター］ - 国会筋によると日銀の植田和男総裁は１３日衆院予算委員会に出席し、午後１時から１時５０分まで落合貴之委員（中道）の質問に答える。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：サービス価格上昇に加速の気配、日銀の緩和修正判断に影響も コラム：漸進的な日銀の緩和修正、ドル130円割れは短期間か＝植野大作氏 コラム：食品値下げは広がるのか、日銀判断にも影響する分岐点に コラム：日銀の背中押す春闘、植田総裁会見で占う「次」の展開 コラム：日銀マイナス金利解除、3月のイメージ強めた高田委員の発言 最終更新: 10/13(火) 8:28 ロイター

item.title: 'Breaking Bad' actor and disability rights activist RJ Mitte dead at 34
item.description: Actor RJ Mitte, whose personal experience living with cerebral palsy informed his role as Walter White Jr, the physically disabled son of a methamphetamine kingpin in the landmark television show "Breaking Bad," died on Monday at age 34.
item.dc:creator: Steve Gorman
item.content:encoded: Actor RJ Mitte, whose personal experience living with cerebral palsy informed his role as Walter White Jr, the physically disabled son of a methamphetamine kingpin in the landmark television show "Breaking Bad," died on Monday at age 34. News of Mitte's death in Brownsville, Texas, was confirmed in a statement released through the talent management agency that represented the actor. No other details about the circumstances of his death were given. "It is with profound sadness that we share the tragic passing of beloved actor, philanthropist, and passionate disability rights advocate RJ Mitte," the statement said. Drawing from his real-life experience with cerebral palsy, Mitte was best known for his breakout role on the AMC cable TV series "Breaking Bad," playing the only son of the lead character, Walter White, a terminally ill high school teacher who descends into a secret life of crime cooking crystal meth. Mitte's character, who adopted the nickname Flynn, used crutches and spoke with a slur, gains greater prominence as the story arc of the series progressed. He starts out as a carefree teenager who largely admires his father but later struggles to reckon with the family' disintegration as the truth about Walter White's "Heisenberg" alter ego emerges. "Mitte brought authenticity to the role and built a platform on disability awareness and inclusion," the statement said, noting that the actor was active in a number of philanthropic organizations devoted to fundraising and awareness for cerebral palsy and other muscle-control disorders. The acclaimed series, often cited by critics as one of the best television dramas of all time, ran from 2008-2013, garnering 16 Emmy awards, including two for best drama series. He later played a high school wrestler with cerebral palsy in the 2021 coming-of-age drama "Triumph." He was a Screen Actors Guild spokesman for performers with disabilities, and a celebrity ambassador for United Cerebral Palsy.

item.title: Actor Selma Blair arrested and accused of abusing flight attendants
item.description: Actor Selma Blair has been arrested after flight attendants reported a "physically abusive passenger" on a Delta Air Lines flight from Los Angeles to New York, the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey's police department said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Actor Selma Blair has been arrested after flight attendants reported a "physically abusive passenger" on a Delta Air Lines (DAL.N) flight from Los Angeles to New York, the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey's police department said on Monday. Police identified Blair, known for roles in the movies "Cruel Intentions" and "Hellboy," as the suspect in an incident on Sunday evening. She was taken into custody at New York's John F. Kennedy Airport and transported to a hospital for evaluation, police said in a statement. Two flight attendants reported injuries and one of them was taken to a hospital, according to the statement. A representative for 54-year-old Blair said she had a medical emergency during the flight. "Selma experienced a medical emergency that led to the alleged conduct," Blair's representative said. "Upon landing, she received immediate medical attention and is currently in stable condition.” Blair has spoken publicly about her battle with multiple sclerosis. She was diagnosed with the autoimmune disorder in 2018.

item.title: 英基地攻撃計画、イラン革命防衛隊が指揮の可能性＝バーナム首相
item.description:
Michael Holden
[ロンドン １２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Michael Holden

[ロンドン １２日 ロイター] - 英国のバーナム首相は１２日、同国南部フェアフォード空軍基地を狙ったとされる攻撃計画について、イラン国内で調整された「可能性が極めて高く」、イスラム革命防衛隊（ＩＲＧＣ）が指揮したのはほぼ確実だという見解を示した。

同基地は、米軍の爆撃機がイランへの攻撃に使用していた。９月２７日未明、近くで英国人の男５人がテロと爆発物関連の犯罪容疑で逮捕され、大規模な警備対応が取られた。

米当局者はロイターに対し、イランが関与したドローン攻撃計画の疑いがあったと説明している。トランプ米大統領は先週、イランに関連する脅威を受け、同基地から爆撃機を撤収させることを決めたと述べた。

バーナム氏は議会で「イラン国内で調整された可能性が極めて高く、イランのイスラム革命防衛隊が指揮したのはほぼ確実だと、われわれは評価している」と述べた。

イランはフェアフォード基地の事件への関与を否定している。

イラン国営通信（ＩＲＮＡ）によると、ムサビ駐英イラン大使は「イラン政府はこの件に一切関与していない。英政府が主張を裏付ける文書や証拠を持っているなら、提示すべきだ」と述べた。

攻撃計画の疑いを巡る詳細は依然としてほとんど明らかになっていない。拘束された５人はその後、訴追されずに「厳しい条件の下で」警察による保釈が認められた。英国とイランの国籍を持つ１人を含む、別に逮捕された男２人も釈放された。

item.title: NYT, Economist among publishers joining coalition to curb unpaid AI use
item.description: The New York Times , Agence France-Presse and The Economist on Monday joined more than 40 publishers in a coalition aimed at preventing AI firms from using or profiting from their content without permission.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The New York Times (NYT.N) , Agence France-Presse and The Economist on Monday joined more than 40 publishers in a coalition aimed at preventing AI firms from using or profiting from their content without permission. The Standards for Publisher Usage Rights (SPUR) coalition, launched in February, now has more than 80 members across over 20 countries. New members include The Atlantic and Brazil's National Association of Newspapers, joining founding members such as the Financial Times, BBC and Associated Press. Publishers are stepping up legal efforts to prevent AI companies from using their content without permission to train large language models. Earlier this month, USA Today (TDAY.N) and several newspapers it owns [USN:L6N45U0ZF TEXT:"sued OpenAI"], alleging copyright infringement. OpenAI and its backer, Microsoft (MSFT.O) , also face similar copyright claims from prominent authors and news organizations, including the New York Times. SPUR, which is funded entirely by its members, is developing industry-wide standards and technical systems to help publishers track and control how AI companies use their content and facilitate licensing agreements, according to its website. "Intellectual property protection and technological advancement can and must co-exist," Rebecca Grossman-Cohen, the New York Times' head of strategic partnerships and chief of staff, said in a statement. Publishers are also grappling with declining referral traffic as search engines roll out AI-generated answers that allow users to consume information without clicking through to websites. Google organic-search referrals to more than 2,500 websites fell 33% globally between November 2024 and November 2025, according to a Reuters Institute report, citing data from Chartbeat. SPUR said it recently introduced its Content Telemetry Standard, designed to standardize how AI agents record and report their use of media content, as part of efforts to ensure creators are compensated for their work.

item.title: ロシア軽油輸出、月300万トン超も トランプ氏発表上回る＝副首相
item.description:
Olesya Astakhova Vladimir Soldatkin
[モスクワ １２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Olesya Astakhova　Vladimir Soldatkin

[モスクワ １２日 ロイター] - ロシアのノバク副首相は１２日、同国の軽油輸出について、トランプ米大統領がロシアとの合意に基づいて示した数量を上回る水準まで回復させることが可能だと述べた。

トランプ氏は９日、ロシアが米国と世界市場に軽油を供給することで合意したと発表。米政権はウクライナ戦争の戦費となるロシアの収入源を断つことを目的に科していた対ロ石油燃料制裁を一時解除した。

ノバク氏は国営テレビ「ロシア２４」で「状況の推移を見極めるが、ロシアには軽油輸出を増やす能力がある」とし、「年末までに輸出は月間３００万─３５０万トンに達し、危機前の水準に戻る可能性がある」と述べた。

ロシアの軽油輸出は、ウクライナによる製油所への攻撃と自主的な輸出制限によって急減した。ウクライナが２０２４─２５年にロシアの製油所に対するドローン（無人機）攻撃を始める前、ロシアの軽油輸出は月間３００万トンを超えていた。

ノバク氏はまた、トランプ氏との合意に基づくロシア産軽油の供給が、世界の需給均衡に一定程度寄与するとの見方を示し、「既にその効果が見られる。世界の軽油市場では価格が約５─６％下落している」と述べた。

トランプ氏は９日、ロシアが米国と世界の市場に３０万トン（２２５万バレル）超の軽油を直ちに供給すると述べた。

米エネルギー情報局（ＥＩＡ）によると、米国の輸送部門だけで日量約２９４万バレルの軽油を消費しており、この供給量は１日分にも満たない。

トランプ氏はまた、ロシアが１１月にさらに５０万トンを供給し、「その直後」にさらに１００万トンを供給すると述べた。

item.title: 仏スーパー冷蔵設備に大規模サイバー攻撃、食品廃棄や火災で当局調査
item.description:
Leo Marchandon Gabriel Stargardter
[パリ １２日 ロイター] - フランスで多数の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
仏スーパー冷蔵設備に大規模サイバー攻撃、食品廃棄や火災で当局調査 7:59 配信

仏ナント近郊のスーパーマーケットの冷凍食品売り場が閉鎖されている様子。10月12日撮影。REUTERS/Stephane Mahe

Leo Marchandon　Gabriel Stargardter

[パリ １２日 ロイター] - フランスで多数のスーパーマーケットの冷蔵・冷凍設備を標的にした大規模なサイバー攻撃が行われ、冷蔵庫や冷凍庫の温度が一晩で最高５０度まで上昇した。これにより食品の損失や火災が発生し、当局が調査を進めている。

パリ検察当局は１２日に「フランス国内の複数の大手食品小売業者のネット接続型冷蔵設備に影響を及ぼす大規模攻撃」が起きたと発表した。

ルコルニュ首相は国家情報システム安全庁（ＡＮＳＳＩ）に調査を指示した。首相府関係者によると、当局は欧州各国と連携し、他国への影響の有無やフランス企業へのリスクを調べている。

サイバー脅威分析会社セコイア・スレット・ディテクション・アンド・リサーチのフェリックス・エメ上級アナリストは、スペイン、ポルトガル、ポーランド、ドイツ、ベルギーでも被害が確認されていると述べた。

フランスでは小売り大手カルフールが、約８０店舗が被害を受けたと明らかにしたほか、約４９０店舗を運営する食品スーパー大手モノプリは、全店舗の約５％で影響が出たと説明した。また食品スーパーのインターマルシェを傘下に持つレ・ムスクテールによると、約１５０店舗の冷蔵設備が一晩のうちに約６時間にわたり５０度まで加熱された。広報担当者は健康リスクを避けるため影響を受けた食品を全て廃棄したと述べた。

パリ中心部のインターマルシェでは、従業員らが解凍された冷凍食品を大型ごみ容器に次々と廃棄する様子が確認された。溶けたアイスクリームが壊れた容器から路上に流れ出る場面もあった。

スーパー大手スーパーＵを運営する協同組合Ｕのドミニク・シェルシェ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、自社グループも攻撃対象になったと明らかにするとともに「生鮮食品の保存と国民への食料供給に不可欠な設備を標的にすることは極めて重大で、前例がない」とＸに投稿した。

インターマルシェのティエリ・コティヤールＣＥＯはＢＦＭテレビで「前例のない攻撃」による損失は全国で１日当たり数千万ユーロ規模に上るとの見通しを示した。

欧州小売業団体ユーロコマースのクリステル・デルベルゲ事務局長は「この事案はサプライチェーン全体の強靱性の重要さを浮き彫りにした」と指摘した。

スーパーの冷蔵設備は通常、店舗内の冷蔵・冷凍機器全体を管理する制御盤で運用されており、保守会社が遠隔管理できるようインターネットに接続されている。首相府関係者によると、ＡＮＳＳＩはデンマークのダンフォスが供給したソフトウエアに脆弱性があったことを確認した。

ダンフォスは声明で、フランスで発生した一部の冷凍・冷蔵管理システムへの攻撃を把握しているとした上で、被害設備は「旧式の制御ソフト（ファームウエア）」を使用していたと説明した。同社は利用者に対し、最新ファームウエアへの更新と旧世代システムの移行を従来から推奨していたとしている。

サイバーセキュリティー企業クラロティの調査チーム「チーム８２」は８月９日、ダンフォス製コントローラー「ＡＫ－ＳＭ ８００Ａ」の脆弱性に関する調査結果を公表。ダンフォスが実施したソフトウエア更新により、認証回避や不正なコード実行につながる問題が修正されたとしていた。

フランス小売業連盟（ＦＣＤ）は声明で、ダンフォスに対し「完全な情報開示」を求めた。影響を受けた店舗の一部は既に営業を再開しているとしている。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：円急伸で揺らぐキャリートレード、見つからない次の調達通貨 アングル：世界市場が当面向き合う6つのリスク、地政学や金融政策・ＡＩなど アングル：湾岸諸国、インフラ整備に重点投資　ホルムズ海峡封鎖で紛争耐性強化へ 焦点：仏、財政赤字巡り政局緊迫　大統領選控え市場の不安と格下げ警戒 アングル：中国フォアグラ生産が急拡大、世界首位フランスに迫る勢い 最終更新: 10/13(火) 7:59 ロイター

item.title: Reddit and Perplexity AI clash over law firm's role in data-scraping case
item.description: Reddit has asked a federal judge to block its former law firm Proskauer Rose from defending Perplexity AI in a lawsuit alleging the AI search startup company stole Reddit content, arguing it was dropped like a "hot potato" by lawyers who owed it client loyalties.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded: Reddit has asked a federal judge to block its former law firm Proskauer Rose from defending Perplexity AI in a lawsuit alleging the AI search startup company stole Reddit content, arguing it was dropped like a "hot potato" by lawyers who owed it client loyalties. In a court filing on Friday in Manhattan federal court, Reddit said Proskauer has a conflict of interest due to its past work for Reddit in a whistleblower case. Reddit also said Proskauer earlier vowed it would not represent Perplexity. "Proskauer cannot drop Reddit like a hot potato in favor of Perplexity," Reddit said in its filing. Proskauer contends Reddit has no basis to disqualify the firm. In a court filing on Friday, the firm said its work for Reddit in the whistleblower matter did not create a conflict of interest that should bar the firm from representing Perplexity now. It also denied it ever agreed not to represent Perplexity. Reddit declined to comment other than to refer to its court filings. Perplexity and Proskauer did not immediately respond to requests for comment. The case is part of a wave of copyright cases targeting AI companies over their alleged use of protected content for AI training. Proskauer argues Perplexity should be able to rely on its chosen counsel in a case exposing it to large potential damages. Reddit filed [USN:L6N43X10V TEXT:"the lawsuit"] last year, alleging Perplexity illegally scraped its online forums for data it needs for its online "answer engine" system. Perplexity has denied Reddit’s copyright infringement claims. Reddit has [USN:L6N3F7001 TEXT:"content licensing deals"] with Google and others for AI training. The case is Reddit Inc v. SerpApi LLC et al, US District Court for the Southern District of New York, No. 1:25-cv-08736. For Reddit: Reid Bolton, Matthew Ford and William Gohl of Bartlit Beck For non-party Proskauer: Kevin Perra of Proskauer Rose Read more: [USN:L6N45G0PN TEXT:"Paul Weiss calls bid to disqualify law firm in sugar antitrust case ‘gamesmanship’"] [USN:L6N453144 TEXT:"Law firm Quinn Emanuel wins fight over role in data center case"] [USN:L6N43M061 TEXT:"Trump administration seeks to bar law firm Susman Godfrey from lawyer group's lawsuit"] [USN:L6N3ZZ15P TEXT:"Pfizer, Teva lose bid to disqualify ex-prosecutor in generic drug price‑fixing case"]

item.title: 石油大手トップ、エネルギー会議への参加取りやめ サウジ攻撃受け
item.description:
Sarah El Safty Jana Choukeir
[ドバイ １２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Sarah El Safty　Jana Choukeir

[ドバイ １２日 ロイター] - 複数のエネルギー大手トップが、サウジアラビアの首都リヤドで開催されているＷＰＣエネルギー会議への参加を取りやめた。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるリヤドへの攻撃で死者が出たものの、サウジ当局は会合の開催を続けている。

１１日に開幕した会議には、エクソンモービル、トタルエナジーズ、シェル、シェブロン、ＢＰの最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が出席する予定だった。しかし、主催者が１２日早朝に公表した議事日程からは、いずれの名前も消えていた。

サウジのアブドルアジズ・エネルギー相は１２日の会議冒頭で、リヤドに足を運んだ参加者に謝意を示した。

ＷＰＣエネルギー会議は当初、４月に予定されていたが、米国とイスラエルによる対イラン戦争が２月下旬に始まったことを受けて延期された。サウジは２０２２年１０月に開催国に選ばれた。１９３３年に英国で初開催された同会議がサウジで開かれるのは今回が初めてとなる。

エネルギー大手のＣＥＯはＷＰＣエネルギー会議に例年出席しており、今週も世界の石油・ガス市場やエネルギー安全保障、エネルギー転換について登壇する予定だった。

ＢＰの広報担当者は、会議への「参加に向けてあらゆる努力をした」と説明。「残念ながら、交通の混乱により現地での参加はできない。われわれは地域全体にわたる長年のパートナーシップを非常に重視している」と述べた。

シェルはコメントを控えた。トタルエナジーズ、エクソンモービル、シェブロンはロイターのコメント要請に直ちに回答しなかった。

会議は今週、リヤドの国際空港から約１０キロ離れた会議場で開かれている。同空港は過去１週間に４回攻撃された。

item.title: Penguins acquire Sabres D Ryan Johnson for Caleb Jones, Daniel Laatsch
item.description: The Buffalo Sabres dealt defenseman Ryan Johnson to the Pittsburgh Penguins on Monday in exchange for defensemen Caleb Jones and Daniel Laatsch.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Buffalo Sabres dealt defenseman Ryan Johnson to the Pittsburgh Penguins on Monday in exchange for defensemen Caleb Jones and Daniel Laatsch. Johnson, 25, was a first-round draft pick in 2019 (No. 31 overall) but has appeared in just six games for Buffalo since the start of the 2024-25 campaign. He has spent the start of the 2026-27 season with AHL affiliate Rochester and played the bulk of the past two seasons there as well. In 47 career NHL games, 41 of them coming in the 2023-24 campaign, Johnson has tallied seven assists and 18 penalty minutes. Jones, 29, played in seven games for the Penguins last season and tallied one assist. The younger brother of four-time All-Star Seth Jones also served a 20-game suspension for violating the league's performance-enhancing substances policy. The Sabres will be Jones' sixth team after stints with Edmonton (2018-21), Chicago (2021-23), Colorado (2023-24), Los Angeles (2024-25) and Pittsburgh. In 255 career games, Jones has recorded 14 goals and 42 assists with 90 penalty minutes. Laatsch, 24, has yet to make his NHL debut. He was a seventh-round draft pick by the Penguins in 2021, but spent four years at Wisconsin before making his professional debut in 2025. --Field Level Media

item.title: Wall Street cai antes de resultados e dados econômicos; petróleo sobe
item.description: O índice Nasdaq Composite, com forte presença de empresas de tecnologia, fechou em baixa nesta segunda-feira, com a alta de quase US$2 por barril nos preços do petróleo após ataques a um aeroporto na Arábia Saudita. Os investidores aguardavam o início da temporada de balanços do terceiro trimestre dos bancos e a divulgação de dados econômicos nesta semana.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O índice Nasdaq Composite, com forte presença de empresas de tecnologia, fechou em baixa nesta segunda-feira, com a alta de quase US$2 por barril nos preços do petróleo após ataques a um aeroporto na Arábia Saudita. Os investidores aguardavam o início da temporada de balanços do terceiro trimestre dos bancos e a divulgação de dados econômicos nesta semana. O índice S&P 500 encerrou o pregão com leve queda, enquanto o Dow Jones subiu. Os contratos futuros de petróleo subiram após os ataques mortais ao aeroporto internacional de Riad no fim de semana. Os ataques ofuscaram a perspectiva de aumento da oferta, depois que o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, elogiou as novas exportações de diesel russo e falou sobre um cessar-fogo entre Rússia e Ucrânia em relação a metas energéticas. Nos próximos dias, os investidores norte-americanos estarão atentos aos resultados corporativos, com os principais bancos dos EUA, incluindo Goldman Sachs (GS.N) , Citigroup (C.N) e JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) , divulgando seus resultados na manhã de terça-feira. Analistas previam que os lucros das empresas do S&P 500 subiriam 30,6% no terceiro trimestre, segundo dados da LSEG IBES. Também serão divulgados esta semana os dados de setembro sobre a inflação ao consumidor e ao produtor nos EUA, bem como os números de vendas no varejo. Embora o mercado de títulos do Treasury norte-americano tenha permanecido fechado na segunda-feira devido ao feriado do Dia de Colombo, os investidores têm se mostrado cautelosos com a recente alta dos rendimentos dos títulos, que atingiram máximas em 24 anos, em um contexto de preços elevados da energia que alimentaram as preocupações com a inflação. "Olhando para o restante da semana, teremos alguns relatórios econômicos importantes", disse Tim Ghriskey, estrategista sênior de portfólio da Ingalls & Snyder em Nova York. Ele acrescentou que os investidores também estavam cautelosos devido à falta de direcionamento do mercado de títulos. "Também estamos aguardando os resultados financeiros, e isso é significativo. Os balanços dos quatro grandes bancos, que serão divulgados na terça-feira, podem ter um grande impacto", disse ele. O Índice Dow Jones Industrial (.DJI) subiu 195,60 pontos, ou 0,38%, para 51.850,55; o S&P 500 (.SPX) perdeu 4,30 pontos, ou 0,06%, fechando em 7.807,24; e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) perdeu 120,27 pontos, ou 0,44%, para 27.245,90. O volume de negociações foi relativamente baixo, com 12,67 bilhões de ações negociadas nas bolsas americanas, em comparação com a média móvel de 20 dias de 17,62 bilhões. "Há muitos motivos para cautela", disse Robert Pavlik, gestor sênior de portfólio da Dakota Wealth em Fairfield, Connecticut, referindo-se aos dados e resultados financeiros que serão divulgados em breve, além da alta dos preços do petróleo. "Você está caminhando ao longo de uma linha férrea e não sabe, porque está escuro, se um trem está vindo, então, sabe, você fica sendo muito cuidadoso", disse ele. Com o aumento dos preços do petróleo, o setor de energia (.SPNY) teve um desempenho superior entre os 11 principais setores industriais do S&P 500, com um avanço de 1,5%. O setor defensivo de bens de consumo essenciais (.SPLRCS) subiu mais de 1%, juntamente com o índice de serviços de comunicação do S&P 500 (.SPLRCL) , que foi impulsionado por um ganho de mais de 3% da gigante Meta (META.O) . Tecnologia (.SPLRCT) , com queda de 0,9%, e consumo discricionário (.SPLRCD) , com queda de 0,7%, foram os maiores retardatários do setor. A fraqueza da tecnologia foi mais pronunciada entre as ações de chips, com o índice de chips da Filadélfia (.SOX) fechando em queda de 2,7% após atingir a mínima de três semanas. No segmento de consumo discricionário, as ações da Chipotle Mexican Grill (CMG.N) caíram 3,8% depois que a Starbucks (SBUX.O) disse que não compraria a rede de burritos. As ações da Starbucks fecharam em alta de 1,7%. A Microsoft (MSFT.O) fechou em alta de 1,1%, com sua capitalização de mercado ultrapassando US$4 trilhões pela primeira vez em um ano, após o anúncio de planos para uma grande implantação de seus próprios chips de IA. As ações da Salesforce (CRM.N) subiram 2% depois que o BofA Global Research elevou a recomendação para "compra", de "desempenho abaixo da média". O eBay (EBAY.O) também subiu 2% depois que o Morgan Stanley adicionou o papel à sua lista de melhores escolhas. Enquanto isso, a presidente do Federal Reserve de Cleveland, Beth Hammack, afirmou que o banco central norte-americano deveria adotar "relativamente rápido" uma postura de política monetária mais restritiva para combater a inflação, que, em sua opinião, tornou-se mais generalizada e está começando a influenciar os planos de precificação das empresas. Segundo a ferramenta FedWatch da CME, os investidores estavam precificando uma probabilidade de quase 22% de que o Federal Reserve dos EUA aumentasse as taxas de juros neste mês, um aumento em relação aos 17,7% registrados na sexta-feira. Na Bolsa de Valores de Nova York (NYSE), o número de ações em queda superou o de ações em alta em uma proporção de 1,09 para 1, com 149 novas máximas e 272 novas mínimas. Na Nasdaq, 1.888 ações subiram e 3.008 caíram, com o número de ações em queda superando o de ações em alta em uma proporção de 1,59 para 1. O índice S&P 500 registrou 10 novas máximas de 52 semanas e cinco novas mínimas, enquanto o Nasdaq Composite registrou 51 novas máximas e 318 novas mínimas. (Por Sinéad Carew e Ragini Mathur)

item.title: Coventry savour first home Premier League win in 25 years
item.description: Coventry City appear to have found their feet in the Premier League after claiming their first home win of the season with a thumping 4-1 victory over Newcastle United on Monday, while the visitors were left with more soul-searching.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Coventry City appear to have found their feet in the Premier League after claiming their first home win of the season with a thumping 4-1 victory over Newcastle United on Monday, while the visitors were left with more soul-searching. An early Jack Rudoni penalty was followed by goals from Sidiki Cherif, Ellis Simms and Stephen Mfuni as Coventry made it two wins from two following a difficult start to the campaign and a first home win in the top flight for 25 years. "Very, very satisfying. It's so hard to win," Coventry manager Frank Lampard said. "We played like the team that we want to be. There is so much spirit and energy in the group and we know we are going to have to suffer a lot this season. "The work ethic of the boys and the belief, you get what you deserve, which is great finishes. We haven't quite had that rub of the green this season that would help us nick more points. "It was a complete performance. We have to keep our feet on the ground. It's a great feeling for the players." There might be euphoria in Coventry, but for Newcastle it was a poor showing in which they missed chances and looked frail at the back. "That's hard. That's punishment in this league. We controlled many phases but it's not enough," Newcastle manager Matthias Jaissle told BBC Sport. "In the boxes the games are decided. In both boxes we were not clean. It's something we need to learn fast. "The momentum was there. We have a young squad but that shouldn't be an excuse. It was a tough game in general. "Today if you see the whole picture, it was not the worst game. But I apologise to fans because they deserved a different result."

item.title: Steve Sarkisian: Surname turns up heat on Texas QB Arch Manning
item.description: Texas coach Steve Sarkisian defended quarterback Arch Manning against the critics on Monday, two days after the Longhorns' last-second loss to archrival Oklahoma that knocked them out of the No. 1 spot in The Associated Press Top 25 poll.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Texas coach Steve Sarkisian defended quarterback Arch Manning against the critics on Monday, two days after the Longhorns' last-second loss to archrival Oklahoma that knocked them out of the No. 1 spot in The Associated Press Top 25 poll. Sarkisian said Manning's pedigree, more than his play, drives the negativity. The senior is a third-generation player (grandfather Archie, father Cooper, uncles Peyton and Eli Manning) who has been in the public eye since early in his prep career in New Orleans. "I think if you took the name off the back of his jersey and you said, ‘Here's Joe Smith playing quarterback at the University of Texas and here's a guy who's beaten four top-10 ranked teams in his last 13 starts,' we'd be praising the guy," Sarkisian said during his media availability in Austin. "But the expectations are high for him, and he understands that. The expectations are high for all of us, so we've got to put our nose back to the grind and get back to work." Manning threw two interceptions against the Sooners, the last coming with 19 seconds remaining in regulation and the game tied. Oklahoma needed just two plays to get into field-goal range and Tate Sandell hit from 47 yards as time expired to give the Sooners the 27-24 upset in Dallas. The Longhorns (4-1, 1-1 Southeastern Conference) dropped to seventh in the AP poll released on Sunday. They own wins over No. 4 Ohio State, which ranked No. 1 when they played Sept. 12 in Austin, Texas, and No. 14 Tennessee. Manning also threw for 260 yards and three touchdowns on Saturday. He has 10 touchdowns to five interceptions in five games and has completed 63.0% of his passes (92-for-146) for 1,122 yards. His 143.32 passer efficiency rating ranks 10th in the SEC and 64th nationally. "It's not fun when it's happening but there's only one way to respond," Manning said in his media availability Monday. "You can let it linger and let it affect the next week, or you can bounce it back. So, you have one choice." Texas hosts Florida (4-2, 2-2), which has lost its last two games, on Saturday. --Field Level Media

item.title: Ronaldo on target as Al-Nassr win after security delay
item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo scored Al-Nassr's second goal as the Saudi Pro League champions overcame an hour-long security delay to beat Uzbekistan's Neftchi 3-1 in the AFC Champions League Elite on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Michael Church
item.content:encoded: Cristiano Ronaldo scored Al-Nassr's second goal as the Saudi Pro League champions overcame an hour-long security delay to beat Uzbekistan's Neftchi 3-1 in the AFC Champions League Elite on Monday. Kick-off was delayed after Saudi Arabia's Civil Defence issued a safety warning 15 minutes before the scheduled start time in Riyadh, which has been targeted by missiles fired from Yemen-based Houthis in recent days. Ange Postecoglou's side shook off the interruption to go in front through Angelo in the 33rd minute with a deflected strike before Ronaldo doubled the lead nine minutes later. The 41-year-old struck after Sadio Mane delivered a looping cross from the left that Aiman Yahya directed into Ronaldo's path with his chest and the Portuguese forward lashed the ball into the bottom corner with a shot on the turn. Alisher Odilov pulled one back for Neftchi six minutes into the second half but Ikromjon Alibaev's red card for a foul on Mohamed Simakan in the 65th minute and an own goal by Anvarjon Gofurov 13 minutes later sealed the win for Al-Nassr. Meanwhile, defending champions Al-Ahli scored twice in the second half to pick up their first win of the new campaign as Marino Pusic's side beat Al-Wasl from the United Arab Emirates 3-1. Roger Ibanez put Al-Ahli ahead with a 20th minute header but Pedro Malheiro levelled in the third minute of first-half stoppage time. Goals from Trincao and Feras Al-Brikan in the 58th and 91st minutes respectively moved Al-Ahli onto four points from their opening two matches. "We created also in the first half but in the second half we made our goals and I think that was the difference," said Trincao. "Physically we were a little bit better and that was the key to changing the game." Houssine Rahimi scored twice as Al-Ain defeated Air Force Club 4-1 in Basra, while Hossein Goudarzi's 60th minute goal earned Iran's Esteghlal a 2-1 win over Al-Gharafa. A last minute penalty from Dostonbek Khamdamov salvaged a 1-1 draw for Pakhtakor against Brendan Rodgers' Al-Qadsiah in Tashkent while Tractor from Iran were held to a 0-0 draw by Qatar's Al-Shamal. The top eight finishers in the 16-team league phase in both east and west Asia will progress to the knockout rounds.

item.title: サウジ主導連合、リヤドへのフーシ派弾道ミサイル破壊と発表
item.description: [１２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[１２日 ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派と戦うサウジアラビア主導の連合軍は１２日、フーシ派がサウジの首都リヤドに向けて発射した弾道ミサイルを破壊したと発表した。

ロイターが確認したメッセージによると、サウジはこれに先立ち、リヤドで「敵対的な脅威」の可能性があるとして警報を発令していた。

フーシ派は先週からサウジの空港や石油施設への攻撃を続けている。米国とイランの紛争が波及し、サウジとの戦闘が急速に激化している。

item.title: Moroccan centrist party agrees to form coalition government with three other parties
item.description: Morocco's centrist Authenticity and Modernity Party (PAM), who topped last month's parliamentary election vote, will form a coalition government with three other parties, the four parties said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Ahmed Eljechtimi
item.content:encoded: Morocco's centrist Authenticity and Modernity Party (PAM), who topped last month's [USN:L8N45G056 TEXT:"parliamentary election"] vote, will form a coalition government with three other parties, the four parties said on Monday. The four — which include moderate socialist parties and the nationalist Istiqlal — together hold 207 seats in parliament, above the 198 needed for a majority. The deal "produces a strong political government, made up of components marked by ideological and political proximity, united in, and committed to, a shared reformist vision,” the coalition said in a joint statement, adding that they will next propose a cabinet lineup. The king [USN:L8N45G056 TEXT:"appointed PAM leader"] Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri as the country's first woman to act as head of government and tasked her with forming a cabinet after PAM finished first in the September 23 vote. PAM was founded in 2008 by an adviser to the king and has positioned itself as a counterweight to the Islamist Justice and Development Party, advocating social modernisation. The new government will oversee the final stages of a $20-billion push to prepare for the 2030 World Cup, which Morocco will co-host with Portugal and Spain. It faces pressure to address [USN:L6N4580D4 TEXT:"youth grievances"] over jobs, education and health services, which fuelled the [USN:L6N3VN095 TEXT:"Gen Z protests"] last year and the [USN:L1N43Y04J TEXT:"Ceuta migration crisis"] in July. [USN:L6N4580D4 TEXT:"The vote"], however, is not expected to change policy direction in Morocco, a constitutional monarchy where the king retains sweeping powers over foreign policy, defence and other key portfolios.

item.title: 需要抑制には利上げ必要、雇用への悪影響望まず＝クリーブランド連銀総裁
item.description:
Howard Schneider
[クリーブランド １２日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は１...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
需要抑制には利上げ必要、雇用への悪影響望まず＝クリーブランド連銀総裁 7:06 配信

米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁。8月27日、ワイオミング州ジャクソンホールで撮影。REUTERS/Ann Saphir

Howard Schneider

[クリーブランド １２日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は１２日、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が雇用市場に打撃を与えずにインフレを抑制できることを期待していると述べた。ただ、そのためには企業投資の急拡大や、個人消費を押し上げている市場主導の資産効果を抑える必要があるかもしれないとの見方を示した。

ハマック氏はロイターのインタビューで、こうした要因が需要を押し上げ、２．５─３．０％の範囲にとどまっているように見えるインフレの持続につながっていると指摘。制約的な金融政策でこれらを十分に抑えれば、失業率が現在の４．２％を上回らずにインフレ率が低下する可能性があると述べた。

企業幹部との会話を振り返り、「活動を縮小しようとしているという話よりも、景気が好調だという話を多く耳にする」とした上で、「成長は好ましく、成長を止めようとしているわけではない。価格に過度な圧力をかけない程度のペースにまで、少しだけ減速させたいだけだ」と述べた。

「設備投資の面で抑制できれば、消費面での打撃はそれほど大きくならずに済むかもしれない」とし、「どちらが打撃を受けるか正確には分からないが、いずれかの面で活動がある程度減速するのを確認できれば望ましい」と語った。

需要を抑制するには金利を引き上げる必要があると考えているものの、１０月２７─２８日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）では、９月の利上げに続いて利上げすべきかどうかについて「予断を持たずに」臨むと述べた。ハマック氏は今年のＦＯＭＣで投票権を持ち、７月の会合では利上げを支持して反対票を投じた。

同氏は「経済に対する制約を強める必要があると思う。ただ、どの程度の期間をかけて行うかは、私にとってまだ結論の出ていない問題だ」と述べた。

インフレ率が高い一方、労働市場は完全雇用に近い状態で安定しているとし、「われわれが課題に直面しているのは、二つの責務のうち一方だけだ」と指摘。「現時点での私の焦点は、インフレに注意を向けることであり、不必要に労働市場を弱めないよう、慎重に進めることだ」と語った。

個人消費については「主に高所得層と資産効果に支えられているように見える」とし、「消費と投資の両方が現在、経済をけん引している」との見方を示した。

＜インフレ心理＞

ハマック氏は、人工知能（ＡＩ）ハイパースケーラー（大規模クラウド事業者）による投資が絶え間なく続き、費用が度外視される中、資源を奪い合う企業の間でインフレ心理が既に根付きつつある可能性を懸念していると述べた。

こうした企業は業績も好調で、投資意欲が旺盛なため、経営幹部はインフレが高止まりすることを前提に計画を立て、投入コストの上昇率を上回る値上げを見込んでいるという。

同氏は、こうした投資需要を抑えられれば、人員削減を伴わずにインフレを和らげる一助となり得るとし、「データセンターから始まったのかもしれないが、より広い範囲に影響が及び始めていると思う。その動きを少しだけ抑えたい」と語った。

「私が使えるのは、細かな調整が利かない一つの手段だけだ。それを使うことが私の役割だと考えている。慎重に使いたい。適切な度合いで、適切な速さで使っていることを確かめたい。ただ、経済への抑制を強める必要があると思う」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 焦点：トランプ政権の影で歩み寄るカナダとＥＵ、準加盟提示でも見える限界 最終更新: 10/13(火) 7:31 ロイター

item.title: 北朝鮮、12日に戦術弾道ミサイル発射 技術改良を確認＝ＫＣＮＡ
item.description: [ソウル １３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ソウル １３日 ロイター] - 北朝鮮国営の朝鮮中央通信（ＫＣＮＡ）は１３日、戦術弾道ミサイルの発射実験が１２日に行われたと伝えた。

ミサイルの重要な中核要素の技術的改良が成功したことが確認されたとしたが、詳細は明らかにしていない。

米太平洋軍は北朝鮮による１２日のミサイル発射について、米国の要員や領土、同盟国に差し迫った脅威をもたらすものではなかったと表明した。

日韓の防衛当局は１２日、北朝鮮が東岸沖へ複数の弾道ミサイルを発射したと発表していた。

一方、北朝鮮の金正恩朝鮮労働党総書記は１１日、自身の指導下で達成された兵器開発の成果を展示する国防工業博物館を視察した。

ＫＣＮＡによると、金氏は北朝鮮の地位を高める兵器について、「一層力を入れて開発し、完成させていく」と述べた。

トランプ米大統領は１２日、アジア訪問の際に金氏と会談する可能性があると述べた。記者団に「そうするかもしれない。わくわくするだろう。彼とは良好な関係にある」と語った。

item.title: トランプ氏、ロシア軽油合意を擁護 超党派議員は違法の可能性指摘
item.description:
Steve Holland
[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Steve Holland

[ワシントン １２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１２日、ロシアとの軽油供給合意を擁護した。共和、民主両党の議員からは、ロシアがウクライナへの侵略を終えるまでロシア産エネルギーの輸入を禁じる米国の法律に違反する可能性があるとの批判が出ている。

トランプ氏は、燃料価格の高騰を抑えるため対策を講じていると説明した。燃料価格は同氏が７カ月前にイランとの戦争を始めて以降、急上昇しているが、同氏はウクライナによるロシアの製油所への攻撃が主な要因の一つだと非難している。

トランプ氏は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）への投稿で「私は米国民のために正しい選択をした。常に米国第一だ！　ドナルド・Ｊ・トランプ大統領」と記した。

トランプ氏は９日、ロシアが世界市場への軽油供給に同意したと発表した。

item.title: Video de colapso de inmueble fue grabado durante sismo en 2017 en México, no en Panamá
item.description: Advertencia: algunos enlaces contienen sonidos que pueden resultar estresantes
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Advertencia: algunos enlaces contienen sonidos que pueden resultar estresantes Un video del derrumbe de un edificio en Ciudad de México grabado en septiembre de 2017 fue erróneamente identificado en redes sociales como ocurrido en Panamá tras un sismo de magnitud 7.7 el 9 de octubre. Estos son los detalles clave: Publicaciones en redes sociales comparten un video del derrumbe de una construcción de cuatro niveles mientras suena una alerta. El 9 de octubre un [USN:S0N43Y04B TEXT:"sismo"] de magnitud 7.7 golpeó el sur de Panamá y al 11 de octubre no había provocado [USN:L6N45X08G TEXT:"muertes"], aunque sí había dejado 27 personas heridas y daños en construcciones. Sin embargo, el video fue publicado el 19 de septiembre de 2017 por medios mexicanos tras el sismo de magnitud 7.1 que [USN:KCN1BW001 TEXT:"azotó"] la Ciudad de México. Reuters geolocalizó el edificio en la alcaldía de Benito Juárez de la Ciudad de México. Una comparación del video con capturas de Google Street View tomadas en agosto de 2017 muestra elementos similares como postes de electricidad, un vehículo y una puerta de una construcción cercana. El edificio fue reconstruido y entregado a las familias afectadas en enero de 2021, según autoridades de la Ciudad de México que no respondieron inmediatamente a una solicitud de comentarios. Veredicto: Erróneamente etiquetado. El video fue grabado en Ciudad de México durante el sismo del 19 de septiembre de 2017. Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos. Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

item.title: Cardinals finalize Marvin Harrison Jr. trade; GM says decision not easy
item.description: One day after Texans coach DeMeco Ryans revealed the acquisition in his postgame press conference, the Arizona Cardinals announced on Monday their trade of wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr. to Houston.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: One day after Texans coach DeMeco Ryans revealed the acquisition in his postgame press conference, the Arizona Cardinals announced on Monday their trade of wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr. to Houston. The final terms were Harrison and a 2027 sixth-round draft pick to Houston in exchange for second- and seventh-round picks in 2027 to Arizona. Previous reports had said the Cardinals were sending Harrison and a seventh-rounder in exchange for a second and a sixth. The trade is still pending a physical. "Decisions like this are never easy," Cardinals general manager Monti Ossenfort said in a statement. "Ultimately, we have to do what is best for our football team and that will always be the driving factor. We are extremely grateful to Marvin for what he has contributed to our organization and wish him the very best as he moves forward in his career." The Cardinals (1-4) figure to be sellers before the Nov. 10 trade deadline as they face an uphill climb in the stacked NFC West. Harrison was held out of Sunday's game, which Arizona lost 45-21 to the Detroit Lions, because a trade agreement had been struck. Four games into his third season in the NFL, Harrison heads to a new team and reunites with C.J. Stroud, his college quarterback at Ohio State. The Texans (1-4) were expected to compete for the AFC South title, but lost their first four games before defeating winless Tennessee 26-3 on Sunday. The fourth overall pick of the 2024 draft, Harrison was eclipsed by Michael Wilson as Arizona's No. 1 receiver. After he hauled in 62 receptions for 885 yards and eight touchdowns in his rookie campaign, Harrison's output dropped to 41 catches for 608 yards and four TDs while being limited to 12 games in 2025. The son of Pro Football Hall of Famer Marvin Harrison, he has five receptions for 85 yards and one score this season. He joins a Houston receiving corps led by two-time Pro Bowler Nico Collins (19 catches, 249 yards, three TDs in three games), Xavier Hutchinson (16 catches, 231 yards) and Kayshon Boutte (12 catches, 153 yards). --Field Level Media

item.title: EEUU espera que acuerdo diesel pueda "ablandar" postura de Moscú sobre negociaciones de paz: fuentes
item.description: Los enviados del presidente Donald Trump comunicaron el viernes a las autoridades ucranianas que un acuerdo para permitir las exportaciones de diesel ruso forma parte de un intento por atraer a Moscú de nuevo a la mesa de negociaciones, dijeron a Reuters tres fuentes.
item.dc:creator: Erin Banco, Daniel Flynn, Gram Slattery
item.content:encoded: Los enviados del presidente Donald Trump comunicaron el viernes a las autoridades ucranianas que un acuerdo para permitir las exportaciones de diesel ruso forma parte de un intento por atraer a Moscú de nuevo a la mesa de negociaciones, dijeron a Reuters tres fuentes. El enviado de Trump para Oriente Medio, Steve Witkoff, y su yerno, Jared Kushner, explicaron a los ucranianos que el presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin, no estaba dispuesto a negociar el fin de la guerra y que el acuerdo anunciado la semana pasada podría ayudar a reanudar las conversaciones trilaterales, afirmaron dos fuentes, que hablaron bajo condición de anonimato. La tercera persona afirmó que Estados Unidos transmitió a los ucranianos que el acuerdo sobre el diesel podría ayudar a "suavizar" la postura de Moscú, en parte porque "envía una señal de que Trump está dispuesto a hacer cosas" con Rusia. Ese acuerdo, en virtud del cual Rusia suministrará más de 2,25 millones de barriles de diesel a los mercados, ha provocado una reacción negativa por parte de algunos legisladores estadounidenses, que afirman que proporcionará a Moscú fondos para continuar con su guerra sin obligar a Putin a hacer concesiones para poner fin al conflicto. El lunes, Trump defendió públicamente el acuerdo. Trump también quería que los ucranianos dejaran de atacar las refinerías rusas, dijo Kushner en la reunión, reiterando que Washington había planteado esa petición en varias ocasiones, según afirmaron ambas personas. Trump ha dicho que los ataques de Ucrania están aumentando los precios mundiales del combustible, pero la mayoría de los expertos sostienen que la guerra en Irán es el principal factor que impulsa los altos costes. "La idea era que EEUU pudiera volver a dirigirse a Rusia y decir: 'Miren, los ucranianos han dejado de atacar y les hemos concedido este acuerdo. Ahora es turno de que ustedes hagan algo'", afirmó una de las fuentes. Trump anunció el domingo un alto el fuego energético entre Rusia y Ucrania, días después de dar a conocer el acuerdo. Sin embargo, las partes no han confirmado tal medida, y Rusia atacó el lunes objetivos energéticos dentro de Ucrania, mientras el portavoz del Kremlin, Dmitry Peskov, rechazó una propuesta del presidente Volodimir Zelenski para una tregua total de 60 días. La embajada rusa en Washington y la oficina presidencial en Kiev no respondieron de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. Una persona cercana al Kremlin afirmó que el acuerdo sobre el gasóleo "es una forma de traer de vuelta a Rusia" a las negociaciones. Una de las personas familiarizadas con la reunión señaló que el acuerdo sobre el gasóleo es parte de un diálogo más amplio sobre cómo llevar a Ucrania y Rusia de vuelta a la mesa de negociaciones y poner fin a la guerra. Trump ha dicho en repetidas ocasiones que Putin quiere alcanzar un acuerdo para poner fin a la guerra. Funcionarios ucranianos y europeos han expresado sus dudas sobre la disposición del líder ruso a poner fin pronto a la campaña militar. Los funcionarios ucranianos que asistieron a la reunión se mostraron escépticos ante el enfoque estadounidense, que consideran un intento de apaciguar a Rusia mediante acuerdos comerciales, afirmaron las dos personas informadas y un asistente a la reunión. El Gobierno de Trump ya había intentado antes atraer a Putin, entre otras cosas mediante propuestas de alivio de las sanciones y posibles acuerdos sobre minerales. Ninguna de estas medidas ha cambiado sustancialmente las exigencias fundamentales de Rusia ni la ha persuadido para que acepte un acuerdo de alto el fuego integral. La persona cercana al Kremlin afirmó que Putin solo volverá a la mesa de negociaciones cuando "consiga el 11% restante del Donbás, lo que podrá presentar a nivel nacional como una victoria". Ucrania ha declarado que no cederá más territorio a Rusia, pero que congelar el conflicto en las líneas de frente actuales podría ser la base para un acuerdo de paz.

item.title: Petróleo sobe com ataques na Arábia Saudita ofuscando acordo de Trump sobre diesel
item.description: Os preços do petróleo subiram quase US$2 por barril nesta segunda-feira, com os ataques à Arábia Saudita superando a perspectiva de aumento da oferta, mesmo com o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, elogiando as novas exportações de diesel russo e o cessar-fogo entre Rússia e Ucrânia sobre metas energéticas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os preços do petróleo subiram quase US$2 por barril nesta segunda-feira, com os ataques à Arábia Saudita superando a perspectiva de aumento da oferta, mesmo com o presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, elogiando as novas exportações de diesel russo e o cessar-fogo entre Rússia e Ucrânia sobre metas energéticas. Os contratos futuros de petróleo Brent fecharam em alta de US$1,93, ou 1,8%, a US$106,65 o barril, o maior valor desde 15 de setembro. O petróleo bruto West Texas Intermediate (WTI) dos EUA fechou a US$93,74 o barril, com alta de US$ 1,89, ou 2%. Os houthis, alinhados ao Irã, reivindicaram a autoria de um ataque no sábado ao aeroporto internacional de Riad, que matou 13 pessoas e feriu mais de 300. Outros ataques ocorreram no domingo, intensificando o conflito que pode prejudicar ainda mais o fornecimento de petróleo bruto de um dos maiores produtores mundiais. "O chocante ataque de mísseis dos Houthis ao aeroporto de Riad, na Arábia Saudita, obviamente intensificará a retaliação contra os Houthis no Iêmen", disse o investidor e analista Louis Navellier em nota. "Neste momento, as refinarias da Arábia Saudita estão operando, mas cinco delas foram fechadas temporariamente quando um oleoduto para o Mar Vermelho foi interditado após os ataques com mísseis." Foram relatados mais ataques a petroleiros que navegam pelo Estreito de Ormuz neste mês, o que ameaça prejudicar a recuperação das exportações de petróleo bruto do Oriente Médio observada em setembro. Um navio-tanque foi atingido por um drone nas proximidades de Sohar, em Omã, enquanto outro foi danificado durante a travessia do Estreito de Ormuz, informou a United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations. "A sensação de alguma normalidade nas exportações do Estreito de Ormuz foi abalada na semana passada. Novos ataques dos houthis contra a Arábia Saudita agravaram a situação e contribuíram para o aumento dos preços", afirmou Bjarne Schieldrop, analista de commodities da SEB. "Cada vez mais, será preciso fazer escolhas difíceis sobre o que defender: infraestrutura petrolífera, instalações militares, palácios reais, aeroportos civis ou outros." Em nota, o Goldman Sachs elevou sua previsão para o preço do Brent em dezembro de US$85 para US$90 por barril, estimando um prêmio de risco de pouco mais de US$20 por barril. Eles acrescentaram que os preços do WTI provavelmente permanecerão baixos em relação ao Brent devido aos altos custos de transporte entre os EUA e a Europa, com uma média de US$ 81 em dezembro de 2026 e US$73 em 2027. No Golfo do México, as gigantes do setor energético Shell, Chevron e BP estavam buscando redistribuir pessoal e restaurar a produção em suas plataformas depois que o furacão Isaías atingiu a terra no início do sábado. MAIS DIESEL RUSSO Os futuros de gasóleo ICE caíram 2,3%, para US$1.449 por tonelada métrica, depois que Trump afirmou na sexta-feira que a Rússia fornecerá imediatamente mais de 300 mil toneladas métricas (2,25 milhões de barris) de diesel para os mercados norte-americano e global, com mais a ser fornecido posteriormente. "A liberação de liquidez ocorrerá gradualmente ao longo do restante deste ano, e os volumes esperados para o próximo mês não parecem capazes de exercer muita pressão adicional sobre os preços", disse o analista Jim Ritterbusch, da Ritterbusch and Associates, na Flórida. Ele observou ainda que não espera uma grande redução nos preços até as eleições de meio de mandato nos EUA, que ocorrerão daqui a três semanas. "O impacto imediato do acordo é questionável, já que a capacidade de refino da Rússia foi severamente reduzida", disse o analista da PVM, Tamas Varga. "No entanto, Moscou suspendeu parcialmente sua proibição de exportação de diesel, permitindo a liberação de 500 mil toneladas (cerca de 3,7 milhões de barris) no mercado internacional — o equivalente a aproximadamente um dia de consumo dos EUA e cerca de 13% da demanda global." Trump também anunciou inesperadamente no domingo que a Ucrânia e a Rússia haviam concordado com um cessar-fogo abrangendo a infraestrutura energética. O líder ucraniano Volodymyr Zelenskiy acusou a Rússia de violar o cessar-fogo energético na segunda-feira, enquanto a Rússia não se pronunciou. Fatih Birol, da Agência Internacional de Energia, afirmou que todos os membros devem avaliar se são necessárias liberações adicionais de diesel e que os países que ainda não cumpriram integralmente os volumes prometidos devem acelerar as liberações, priorizando o diesel. (Por Laila Kearney e Shadia Nasralla)

item.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（12日）ドル1年半ぶり高値圏、ナスダック下落
item.description: ＜為替＞ ドルは１年半ぶりの高値近辺で推移した。中東紛争の激化と週内に発表される重要な米物価指標を前に、投資家が慎重姿勢...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（12日）ドル1年半ぶり高値圏、ナスダック下落 6:49 配信

＜為替＞ ドルは１年半ぶりの高値近辺で推移した。中東紛争の激化と週内に発表される重要な米物価指標を前に、投資家が慎重姿勢を維持する中、安全資産としての需要がドルを支えた。

主要６通貨に対するドル指数は０．３７％高の１０２．５８と、２０２５年４月以来の高水準となった。

投資家はドルの買い持ちを増やしている。１０月７日までの週の買い持ち額は約３６０億ドルと、３週間前の８４億ドルから拡大した。主にユーロ売りを伴う動きだった。

ドルは対円で０．２％高の１５８．６６円。英ポンドは０．２％安の１．３２０３ドルとなった。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ コロンブス・デーで休場

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ ナスダック総合株価指数が下落して取引を終えた。サウジアラビアの空港への攻撃を受けて原油価格が１バレル＝約２ドル急伸したことに加え、大手銀行による第３・四半期決算発表シーズンの幕開けや、今週発表の経済指標を前に投資家が様子見姿勢を強めた。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種はほぼ横ばいで終了し、ダウ工業株３０種は上昇した。

今後数日間は企業決算が焦点となる。ゴールドマン・サックス、シティグループ、ＪＰモルガン・チェースなど米大手銀行が１３日朝に決算を発表する。ＬＳＥＧのＩＢＥＳデータによると、アナリストはＳ＆Ｐ５００種構成企業の第３・四半期利益が３０．６％増加すると予想している。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の主要１１業種では、原油高を受けてエネルギーが１．５％上昇し、上昇率が最大となった。ディフェンシブ銘柄で構成する主要消費財は１％超上昇。通信サービスも１％超上昇した。通信サービスは、指数への寄与度が大きいメタが３％超上昇したことに支えられた。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 米インフレ指標の発表を控え、ドル高と原油高を背景に一時１週間ぶり高値を付けた後、下落した。スポット金は午後２時４５分（日本時間午前３時４５分）時点で０．６％安の１オンス＝４１６９．１０ドル。米金先物１２月限の清算値は０．６％安の１オンス＝４１９０．６０ドルだった。米政府と債券市場はコロンブス・デーで休場となった。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ ２ドル近く上昇した。トランプ米大統領が９日、ロシアが米国と世界市場にディーゼル（軽油）を供給することで合意したと発表したものの、サウジアラビアへの攻撃による懸念が供給増加への期待を上回った。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が１．９３ドル（１．８％）高の１バレル＝１０６．６５ドルと、９月１５日以来の高値を付けた。米ＷＴＩ先物は１．８９ドル（２％）高の９３．７４ドルだった。

item.title: North Korea test-fires tactical ballistic missile, KCNA says
item.description: North Korea test-fired a tactical ballistic missile on Monday, state media KCNA reported on Tuesday, adding that the test confirmed the successful technical upgrading of an important core element for the missile, without elaborating.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: North Korea test-fired a tactical ballistic missile on Monday, state media KCNA reported on Tuesday, adding that the test confirmed the successful technical upgrading of an important core element for the missile, without elaborating. The announcement comes after South Korea's military said on Monday that North Korea had fired multiple ballistic missiles toward the sea off its east coast. It was Pyongyang's fourth launch in a month, following Seoul's recent test of a hypersonic missile. Meanwhile, North Korean leader Kim Jong Un on Sunday visited a defence industry museum showcasing weapons achievements made under his leadership. Kim said the country's weaponry, which promotes North Korea's position, "will be developed and completed in a more strenuous manner", KCNA reported. US President Donald Trump said on Monday that he may meet with Kim during a visit to Asia. "I may, yeah. That'll be exciting, won't it? But I get along with him," Trump told reporters.

item.title: Resurge video alterado con frase de AMLO sobre generar pobreza para evitar secuestros
item.description: El expresidente de México Andrés Manuel López Obrador no dijo en una conferencia de prensa que para evitar secuestros la sociedad debe vivir en la pobreza, contrario a publicaciones que comparten la declaración alterada como un registro auténtico.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: El expresidente de México Andrés Manuel López Obrador no dijo en una conferencia de prensa que para evitar secuestros la sociedad debe vivir en la pobreza, contrario a publicaciones que comparten la declaración alterada como un registro auténtico. Estos son los detalles clave: En el video compartido en línea se escucha al exmandatario decir “No secuestran a un pobre, secuestran al que tiene. Entonces, ¿cómo evitamos el secuestro? Con una sociedad pobre”. La declaración fue modificada para reemplazar la frase “una sociedad mejor” por “una sociedad pobre”. La transmisión original es del 12 de junio de 2020. López Obrador dijo : “No secuestran a un pobre, secuestran al que tiene. Entonces, ¿cómo evitamos el secuestro? Con una sociedad mejor, con justicia”. Reuters ha abordado previamente esta [USN:L1N3B12MX TEXT:"declaración"] y [USN:L1N3B12MX TEXT:"otras"] frases editadas atribuidas al expresidente. Veredicto: Alterado. La declaración fue recortada para simular que López Obrador dijo que la sociedad debe ser pobre para evitar secuestros. Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos. Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

item.title: Fed's Hammack: Hope to cool demand, and inflation, without job market pain
item.description: Cleveland Federal Reserve President Beth Hammack said on Monday she hopes the Fed can lower inflation without damaging the job market, but that may entail cooling the blistering pace of corporate investment or the market-driven wealth gains fueling personal consumption.
item.dc:creator: Howard Schneider
item.content:encoded: Cleveland Federal Reserve President Beth Hammack said on Monday she hopes the Fed can lower inflation without damaging the job market, but that may entail cooling the blistering pace of corporate investment or the market-driven wealth gains fueling personal consumption. Those are the factors driving demand and helping sustain inflation that seems lodged in the 2.5%-to-3.0% range, Hammack said in a Reuters interview. They could perhaps be cooled enough by restrictive monetary policy for inflation to decline without unemployment rising beyond the current 4.2% jobless rate, she said. "I hear more that the economy is booming than I hear that people are looking to pull back," Hammack said, recounting conversations with business leaders. "I like growth...I'm not trying to stop growth. I'm just trying to pull it back a little bit so that it's moving at a pace that doesn't put too much pricing pressure out there." "If we can curb it on the capex side, then maybe it doesn't have to hit as much on the consumption side," Hammack said. "I don't know precisely which one gets hit...Just seeing some amount of pullback in activity on either side would be beneficial." Hammack said she feels interest rates need to move higher to restrain demand, but added she would go to the Fed's October 27-28 meeting with an "open mind," specifically about whether the Fed should lift rates then after September's hike. She is a voter on rate policy this year and dissented in July in favor of a rate hike. Investors currently expect the Fed to stay on hold in October. "I think we need to put more restriction in the economy. But over what period of time, it's an open question to me," Hammack said. Still, her comments are among the most explicit from a Fed official about the need to cool demand through restrictive monetary policy. "We're only being challenged on one side of the mandate," with inflation high but the labor market stable around full employment, Hammack said. "So my focus right now is going to be to try to get some attention" on inflation and "do it in a...deliberate fashion so that we don't weaken the labor market if we don't need to." Consumer spending "does seem like it's being held up largely by the top end of the income spectrum and by the wealth effect," she said. "I think it is both the consumption side and I think it's the investment side. Both of those are driving the economy right now." Policymakers have in the past seen a tradeoff between inflation and unemployment, with higher joblessness representing economic "slack" that eases demand, and thus price pressures. INFLATIONARY PSYCHOLOGY Since the COVID-19 pandemic, however, policymakers have offered differing ideas about how to meet their inflation target while maintaining full employment. Some have argued monetary policy could work through an expectations channel, anchoring inflation expectations so that businesses and households restrain their own price and wage demands. Hammack, though, said she is worried an inflationary psychology already may be taking root among firms competing for resources in an environment where investment by artificial intelligence hyperscalers has become relentless, making cost no object. Because those firms are also doing well and are eager to invest, she sees executives planning for inflation to remain high and anticipating price increases greater than the pace at which their input costs are rising. If those investment demands could be trimmed, it could help temper inflation without layoffs, she said. "It may have started with the data centers, but I think it's starting to impact things more broadly. And so I want to just pull back a little bit of that," Hammack said. "I have one blunt instrument to use...and I feel like I'm supposed to use that. I want to use it judiciously. I want to make sure that I'm using it in the right amount, at the right speed. But I think we need to put more restraint in the economy."

item.title: US, Chinese and Indian firms show interest in Peru's $844 million port project
item.description: Investors from countries including the US, China and India are interested in a new port project in southern Peru estimated to cost around $844 million, officials said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Marco Aquino
item.content:encoded: Investors from countries including the US , China and India are interested in a new port project in southern Peru estimated to cost around $844 million, officials said on Monday. The port is expected to have a greater draft depth than Chancay, the northern Peru port operated by China's Cosco Shipping Ports (1199.HK) since late 2024, which accommodates large vessels making nonstop voyages between South America and Asia. "Several companies have approached us," regional governor Rohel Sanchez told reporters after signing an agreement with the state agency Proinversion, aimed at showcasing the project to domestic and foreign investors. "We have investors from the US, China and India who are very interested," he added, without identifying the specific companies involved. China has become a key investor in Peru at a time when Washington is seeking to curb Beijing's influence in Latin America, while the Asian nation remains a key market for Peruvian minerals. While Corio could be a terminal for general cargo and containers, Proinversion President Luis del Carpio did not rule out its use for shipping minerals such as copper sourced from the area to Asia. The government announced in September that China's Jinzhao would begin construction in 2027 of a $405 million port in the town of Marcona, in the Ica region. Sanchez said companies from Turkey and the Netherlands have also shown interest, as have investors from South Korea regarding technological development within the logistics park.

item.title: Trump says he is considering firing US ambassador to Greece

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump said on Monday he was considering firing US Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle. "Well, we're looking at it. Yeah, we're not happy," Trump told reporters.

item.title: Trading Day: Fog of war
item.description: Oil and fuel prices rose on Monday following weekend attacks on a Saudi airport, which had a varied impact on global stocks. Asia shares mostly fell, Europe shares rose, and Wall Street was mixed. The dollar continued its recent rally and hit an 18-month high, and fixed income trading activity was muted as the US bond market was closed for Columbus Day.
item.dc:creator: Jamie McGeever
item.content:encoded:
[USN:L1N45X07R TEXT:"Oil"] and fuel prices rose on Monday following weekend [USN:L6N45Y0OR TEXT:"attacks"] on a Saudi airport, which had a varied impact on global stocks. Asia shares mostly fell, Europe shares rose, and [USN:L4N45Y0IF TEXT:"Wall Street"] was mixed. The [USN:L1N45Y00B TEXT:"dollar"] continued its recent rally and hit an 18-month high, and fixed income trading activity was muted as the US bond market was closed for Columbus Day. In [USN:L6N45V0ZS TEXT:"my column today"], I look at how nervousness around AI is growing, even as stocks climb to new highs. A drip feed of negative news is emerging, and the bar for earnings forecasts is higher than ever. A pullback in stocks at some point is inevitable. But when will it come, and how deep will it be? Today's Key Reads [USN:L6N45Y0OR TEXT:"Saudi Arabia faces new missile and drone fire after major attacks on airports "] [USN:L6N45O0L8 TEXT:"In the US, a wealth boom and a price shock collide "] [USN:L1N45U12M TEXT:"US yield surge triggers mortgage hedging, adds to bond market pressure "] [USN:S0N43A006 TEXT:"IMF says AI investment keeps global growth around 3% but brings massive disruption "] [USN:S8N44O02D TEXT:"Hall, Woodford win Nobel prize for work on how to stabilise economies "] Today's Key Market Moves STOCKS: South Korea -4%, [USN:L6N45Y0B8 TEXT:"Europe"] +0.7%, [USN:L6N45Y0I9 TEXT:"UK"] +1%. Wall Street mixed - Nasdaq -0.4%, Dow +0.4%, S&P 500 flat. SECTORS/SHARES: Three sectors on the S&P 500 rise, eight fall. Energy +1.5%, tech -0.9%. [USN:L4N45Y13Q TEXT:"Meta"] +3.4%, [USN:L6N45V11Z TEXT:"Microsoft"] +1% to 2026 high, [USN:L4N45Y0TG TEXT:"Chipotle"] -3.7%, Starbucks +1.7%. FX: Dollar index highest since April 2025. Dollar/yen 3-week high of 158.70. [USN:L4N45W00Q TEXT:"Indian rupee"] biggest gainer, on RBI action. BONDS: US bond market closed. French, Italian spreads vs Germany widen. COMMODITIES/METALS: Oil +2% on Riyadh strikes.

Today's Talking Points: Wot's ... uh, the deal? If President Donald Trump's surprise [USN:L4N45Y0AR TEXT:"deal"] over the weekend to remove sanctions on Russian diesel and announcement of an [USN:L8N45Y0FT TEXT:"energy ceasefire"] between Russia and Ukraine were intended to help lower US energy prices ahead of the [USN:L6N45U0XS TEXT:"midterm elections"], they have not gotten off to a good start. Markets are taking their cue from events in the Middle East , where [USN:L6N45Y0OR TEXT:"attacks on Riyadh airport"] have heightened already-intense security and supply concerns. On Monday crude oil rose 2%, and US diesel futures edged higher too. In any case, the diesel deal does not look likely to have a lasting impact on prices. The volumes that Trump's Truth Social post said Russia will release over the next three months equate to roughly 12 hours of global diesel consumption. It's barely even a drop in the ocean. Whether it moves the midterms polling dial remains to be seen. If not, and gaspline and diesel prices stay elevated, will Trump find another lever to pull? King dollar The dollar's renaissance is remarkable. It is trading against a basket of major currencies at its highest level since April last year, but even more impressive than that, it has risen 4% in the last month. That's a sizeable move in such a short space of time for any major currency, never mind the world's reserve currency. True, it is coming off a relatively low base. The dollar index was at 4-year low in February. Much of the latest move is due to euro sovereign debt worries slamming the euro. CFTC data shows speculators' "long" dollar positions are quite extended, so perhaps the momentum will begin to cool. That would likely be welcomed in Washington and other capitals around the world. Mixed impact The AI revolution's contribution to the US equity bull market is not in doubt, even though worries about its momentum and market concentration are mounting. Corporate profits - nominal and as a share of GDP - have never been higher, Wall Street's major indexes have never been higher, and it's largely thanks to the trillions being spent on AI. But the impact on US economic growth is much more nuanced. Indeed, from a trade perspective, it's probably negative. The US [USN:L1N45R0RR TEXT:"trade deficit"] is widening, in large part driven by record demand for chips, computer equipment and other industrial machinery needed for the AI infrastructure buildout. The deficit widened to 3% of GDP in Q2 from 2.7% in Q1, and could reach 4% next year, according to economists. All else equal, that's a pretty heavy drag on growth. What could move markets tomorrow?
